script.title: Temple of the Resonant Bell
script.description: An autumn Japanese Buddhist sanctuary. A broad timber stage carries the open worship hall; a bridge reaches a three-tier sutra pagoda, while a suspended temple bell waits in its own pavilion. Sweeping ceramic roofs, timber brackets, lattice screens, a seated golden Buddha and an autumn maple complete the temple.
